text:
Maya: Huge thanks to Devin + Sam for pulling off the last-minute demo rescue and saving the office ficus 🌿 — they rewired the HDMI, re-routed the canary, and bribed the plant with water. Legend.

Sam: lol the ficus is living its best life :laughing: also we didn't bribe, we promised extra plants.

Devin: genuinely team effort — shoutout to Rachael for lending the HDMI dongle, and @infra-oncall-bot for the late-night scaling tweak :heart: 

Rachael: happy to help! also respect for staying calm during panic demo mode :raised_hands: 

Maya: +1 to Sam for smoothie run at 1am :coffee: 

ops-bot: Reminder: demo-podium AC set to 68F. cc @facilities 

James (facilities): got it, turned it down 2 degrees. Also leaving spare dongles in the AV cabinet.

Rachael: can we have a tiny plaque? 'Demo Rescuers 2026' :trophy: 

Maya: omg yes. I'll order stickers. anyone got color preferences?

Devin: green? fits the ficus.

Sam: orange for visibility.

Maya: sticker vote — react with :green_apple: for green, :tangerine: for orange, :seedling: for plant-themed multicolor.

Maya: Voting open! (reacts)

Reactions summary: :green_apple: 3, :tangerine: 1, :seedling: 2

Maya: thanks again team, big love <3
